mainEntity.name: What should I expect during a typical GPP training session at Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical GPP training session at Cave Training involves a varied workout incorporating elements of strength training, metabolic conditioning, gymnastics, and mobility work. You can expect a structured class led by an experienced coach, starting with a warm-up, followed by skill work or strength development, and then a challenging conditioning piece. The focus is on proper movement mechanics and functional exercises that translate to real-world activities. Before your first session, we recommend arriving a few minutes early to discuss any physical limitations or goals with your coach, allowing them to tailor modifications as needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: A typical GPP session at Cave Training includes varied workouts with strength training, conditioning, gymnastics, and mobility, led by a coach. Expect a warm-up, skill work, and a conditioning piece; discuss any limitations with your coach beforehand.
